faq.q: Can I add both a date and my name to the photo?
faq.a: Yes. There are two independent text lines: Line 1 is the date and Line 2 is a name/signature text, each with its own position (nine grid spots), font size, colour, bold toggle, opacity and X/Y offset. You can also drag either line directly on the preview to place it exactly where you want.

DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, and a long form like '15 March 2026'. A 'Use today' button sets the current date. You can also auto-size the text to the image width instead of a fixed pixel size.

faq.q: How do I meet a form's KB size limit?
faq.a: Set a target size in KB and click 'Fit to KB limit'. For JPEG or WEBP it binary-searches the quality (up to 8 steps) to get under your target and reports the quality used; if it can't reach the limit even at lowest quality it tells you to reduce the max width. PNG has no quality control, so it asks you to switch to JPEG or WEBP for a KB target.

faq.q: What do the exam presets actually change?
faq.a: Choosing SSC, UPSC, IBPS/Banking, Railway or State PSC sets sensible defaults — for example whether the name line is shown and where the date and name sit (commonly date bottom-right, name bottom-left) — and shows an informational note about that exam's typical requirement. Every preset reminds you to confirm the exact rule in your own official notification, since rules differ by exam and year. Batch processing and a Download-all ZIP are supported.
